name: remotion-real-ui-video
description: Strict reusable workflow for turning an existing app into code-native Remotion videos that reuse the real app UI/components instead of screenshots, screen recordings, or recreated clone/mock screens. Use when a user wants product demos, walkthroughs, onboarding videos, launch videos, or proof compositions from an existing React/Next/web app with mock/demo/local data, scripted navigation, click/touch choreography, responsive mobile proofs, scroll choreography, or calibrated cursor/tap targeting. Enforces real-UI compliance: agents must inspect and import/extract actual app components before building app-screen scenes, and must stop rather than hand-build lookalike dashboards/forms/tables unless the user explicitly approves a mockup/redesign.
